news.title: Annual Celebration of St. Mark
news.content: Join us for the annual celebration of St. Mark, our patron saint. We will have special liturgy, music, and a community gathering.

news.title: Community Outreach Program
news.content: Our church has launched a new community outreach program to support families in need. We invite volunteers to join us in this noble mission.

news.title: Youth Group Meeting
news.content: Our youth group will meet every Friday at 6:30 PM. We focus on spiritual growth, friendship, and service. Everyone is welcome!

news.title: New Church Music Initiative
news.content: We are proud to announce a new initiative to preserve and teach traditional Ethiopian Orthodox church music. Choir practice begins next month.

news.title: Easter Preparation Begins
news.content: As we enter the fasting season, we will have special services and teachings to prepare our hearts for Easter. Join us for daily prayers at 7 AM.

news.title: Community Dinner Tonight
news.content: All are invited to our community dinner tonight at 6 PM in the fellowship hall. It's a great opportunity to connect with our church family.
